**The native build of 1.4.2.** It's the same code as 1.4.2, published so panels on the **Native** channel get its fixes too. For the Rust system helper that means downloads that only stop when they stall rather than after two minutes, Java installs that take turns instead of sharing a folder, a cap on connections, and a fall-back to Bun if it crashes while starting.

Testing: follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.4.2-native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md) on a spare VPS.
